<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex65012025-04-2211-29-06" status="reviewed">
         <milestone n="Colophon" unit="section"/>
         shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul phyin ci ma log par gsal bar byed pa | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3720">slob dpon bdag nyid chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub</rs> kyis mdzad pa <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5137"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3715">dbu ma rtsa ba</rs>'i <lb n="155a4"/> bstan 'chos kyi 'grel pa 'thad pa'i rgyan</rs> ces bya ba | bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa lnga brgya bdun pa la <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5559">gangs ri'i khrod</rs> du byung ba | rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa | lung dang rigs pas phyug cing zab pa dang rgya che ba'i don la ma rmongs pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3842">shAkya'i dge slong dbu ma smra ba byang <lb n="155a5"/> chub brtson 'grus</rs> kyis legs par sbyar ba rdzogs so ||</seg></TEI>
